title: Magazine cover: a two-ink condensed masthead at 0.17 of the height, a tracked line, a contents column, a sun disc, an orbit and a Googie scene slot on cream
use: Magazine and zine covers, issue announcements, catalogue fronts.

misregister.note: offset of the mustard plate behind the sun (units at 1500 wide)

halftone.note: a code dot screen on the sun

paper.note: aged sheet from materials generate --generator paper (ground layer: sampled for contrast); empty draws the flat ink

art.note: Googie or period scene, 3:2, from a public-domain period source or a task sheet; never drawn

emblem.note: mark slot for the owner's logo, insignia or emblem file (PNG or SVG with alpha), placed with fit contain; square, 0.07 of the width; keep clear space of 0.25 of its side; nothing of the cover inside it; never drawn by the template

tagline.default: THE MAGAZINE OF THE DAY AFTER TOMORROW

default: Cooking at the speed of light
Two weeks on the lunar lido

plus_line.default: • JET-AGE FURNITURE  • DESERT MODERN  • ATOMIC ART

relations: Masthead ink 0.17 of the height, two inks in one word (teal then vermilion), set tight (-10).
Contents column 0.2 of the width at the left margin (0.055), entries alternating teal and vermilion with a rule under each.
Sun disc 0.216 of the width at (0.80, 0.42), an orbit circle of radius 0.31 W through it, a starburst at (0.85, 0.215).
decoration: teal and charcoal blocks, the sun with a code dot screen and a misregistered mustard plate, a small teal disc, the orbit with crosshair ticks, a mobile of three poles, the starburst

provenance.corpus: atomic-age kit (Halcyon Orbital Lines): our own original world in the atomic-age grammar, examples/atomic-age-kit
provenance.experiment: styles/atomic-age/style.json provenance (owner-supplied mood board measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: k-means palette (6 clusters, OKLab-free RGB on a 160 px reduction), light and dark shares, visual-weight centre and proportions read on the board's magazine panel
measured: masthead ink 0.16-0.18 of H, the cool half teal #155056, the hot half vermilion #B33E10
cream #E6CBA4 50.8% of the cover, dark 10.1%, chroma>30 7.8%
sun disc diameter 0.216 W, contents column 0.16 W, left margin 0.054 W
